## Apply Progress: issue-612-scalar-trailing-space (#612)

**Status**: All 4 phases complete (14/14 tasks). Committed as 2 work units on
`fix/issue-612-fixreview-a-trailing-space-on-a-key-line`. NOT pushed, NO PR opened.

### Commits (in order)
1. `1380165` fix(review): scalar() treats a whitespace-only key line as absent (#612)
   — `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs` (regex `(.+)` → `(\S.*)`, JSDoc added)
   — `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.test.mjs` (created — boundary table, NBSP row, trailing-trim row)
2. `e385984` test(review): pin scalar()'s whitespace-only repair across every consumer (#612)
   — `parse-verdict.test.mjs` (F2 rewritten in place, nothing-follows row, axis-11 invariant row)
   — `parse-verdict.mjs` (dropped stale "not repaired" JSDoc claim, lines 127-136)
   — `actor-check.test.mjs` (six-key governance-invariance table, colocated with consumer per D-C)
   — `decision-block.test.mjs` (decision/head_sha/actor whitespace-only refusal rows)
   — `epic-map.test.mjs` (track:/blocks: whitespace-only rows, incl. tracks-map grouping test)
   — `checkpoint-block.test.mjs` (counted_lines: missing-key error text row)
   — `yaml-block.drift.test.mjs` (header comment only, zero assertion changes — verified 8/8 unchanged)

### Verification numbers
- Baseline (branch tip, unmodified): 3821 tests, 0 failures.
- Baseline re-measure (regex-only change applied, before consumer pins): 3821 tests,
  exactly 1 failure — `#452/#478-F2` — matching design's prediction exactly. No second
  failure (would have been stop-and-report).
- Full suite after complete change: 3847 tests, 0 failures (26 new test rows: 11 in
  yaml-block.test.mjs, 2 in parse-verdict.test.mjs, 6 in actor-check.test.mjs, 3 in
  decision-block.test.mjs, 3 in epic-map.test.mjs, 1 in checkpoint-block.test.mjs).
- `npm run brain:repo:check` passed before both commits.
- PR #695 checked (`gh pr view 695`): OPEN, not merged — no rebase needed, flagged
  for whoever lands second (orthogonal file regions per design: #695 touches
  extractFencedBlock's fence location logic, #612 touches scalar's value regex).

### Mutation proof (all 4 required mutants confirmed RED, then restored via `git checkout --`)
- (a) Full revert `(\S.*)` → `(.+)`: 10 tests red across exactly 4 distinct files —
  `yaml-block.test.mjs`, `parse-verdict.test.mjs`, `checkpoint-block.test.mjs`,
  `epic-map.test.mjs`. Matches design's prediction of 4 files exactly (not thinner).
  actor-check.test.mjs and decision-block.test.mjs stayed green under this mutant —
  correctly so, since their "never admits" gates already reject both `''` and `null`.
- (b) `(\S.*)` → `(.*)`: 48 tests red (broad collateral since `(.*)` also breaks the
  bare `key:` case), but specifically kills the NBSP row
  (`scalar: a leading NBSP before a value returns null`) — the row the design says is
  the ONLY thing that kills this mutant.
- (c) Remove `.trim()`: exactly 2 tests red, both in `yaml-block.test.mjs` — the
  `key: v  ` row and the `head_sha: <sha>  ` row. Precisely the required kill, no
  more, no less.
- (d) `[ \t]*` → `\s*`: 41 tests red, including the F2 pin (`#452/#478-F2`) and the
  `/m`-leak row in `yaml-block.test.mjs`, as predicted. Also killed the NBSP row as
  collateral — JS `\s` (no `u` flag) matches U+00A0 per the ECMAScript WhiteSpace
  production, so `\s*` re-admits NBSP through the prefix too.
- Each restore used `git checkout -- brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs` and was
  confirmed via a full `npm test` returning to 3847/3847 and `git status` clean.

### Gotcha hit and corrected mid-session
Ran the FIRST mutation test (full revert) BEFORE committing the real fix. `git
checkout --` reverted the file all the way to the pre-fix (committed) baseline —
correctly restoring from the mutant, but ALSO silently discarding the actual `(\S.*)`
fix, since nothing had been committed yet. Caught it immediately (full-suite check
showed 0 failures instead of the expected mutant-red state was gone, JSDoc was also
gone), re-applied the real fix via Edit, verified GREEN (3847/3847), then committed
both work units BEFORE running any further mutation tests. All mutation tests from
that point on used `git checkout --` safely since a committed restore point existed.
Lesson: when doing mutation testing on an UNCOMMITTED fix, commit the fix first, or
mutation-test restores will wipe it.

### Tasks artifact
`openspec/changes/issue-612-scalar-trailing-space/tasks.md` — all 14 checkboxes
marked `[x]` with actual measured outcomes recorded inline (not just checked off).
